rationale: With the Chief in the majority and advocating a minimalist “recklessness floor,” Roberts is most likely to keep the coalition together by writing a narrow opinion requiring subjective recklessness for true-threat prosecutions. Thomas and/or Alito are likely to write separately to defend an objective standard and resist constitutionalizing mens rea, while one or more majority justices (especially Gorsuch/Barrett/Kagan) may concur to clarify doctrinal or historical limits.
